description:
Adds bees and beehives

Features:

- Find wild beehives generated around the world to get honey and queen bees.
- Use the smoker and grafting tools to harvest honey or swipe a queen bee.
- Craft your own hives and fill with frames and a queen bee to make your own honey.
- Be sure to have plenty of flowers handy for them to feed on.
- Use the honey extractor to empty your frames.
- If Pipeworks mod is installed you can craft and use Industrial Hives.
